title.zh: Consensys与ClearToken达成合作，将为批发金融市场提供全天候结算基础设施
title.en: Consensys与ClearToken达成合作，将为批发金融市场提供全天候结算基础设施

current_state.zh: Consensys and ClearToken announced a strategic partnership to deliver round-the-clock DvP settlement infrastructure for wholesale markets, tokenizing eligible bank securities under the Bank of England's Digital Securities Sandbox and settling against fiat, tokenized deposits, and stablecoins.
current_state.en: Consensys and ClearToken announced a strategic partnership to deliver round-the-clock DvP settlement infrastructure for wholesale markets, tokenizing eligible bank securities under the Bank of England's Digital Securities Sandbox and settling against fiat, tokenized deposits, and stablecoins.
